# F-015 L1 fixes from test31, ~1.5 minutes. Expect: "a ball at 3 mps" opens a motion scene (3 m/s); "30 mps square"
# is an acceleration (30 m/s², not a speed); two circles labelled C1 and C2 (said as tokens, now printed); "remove all
# the diagrams" empties the scene and the title goes back to the cue's; three cars at 60 / 70 / 50 kmph and a boy at
# 20 kmph: names in a column, each car tagged with its said speed, one readout row per body, no overlap; a cuboid
# (6 x 3 x 4 cm) and a cylinder (r 3 cm, h 5 cm) with hidden edges dashed, volume and surface area computed.
@setup subject=Physics grade=9 topic="Shapes and motion"

If the acceleration was 30 mps square.
[pause 3]
